offlineChecks.preflightWithoutCredentials: exit 1 with missing variable names only; Node v18.19.1 correctly rejected because deployment requires >=22

findings: Invalid environment values silently fall back to staging.
Malformed state JSON is treated as empty state and can cause duplicate resource creation.
Supabase database URLs are passed as command arguments and may leak in error text.
State is only persisted after a full successful apply, reducing interruption safety.
The Cloudflare token-factory branch hashes a management token and treats it as an R2 S3 secret; this is not a valid S3 credential flow.
DATABASE_URL and DIRECT_DATABASE_URL are identical instead of separating runtime transaction pooling from migration connectivity.
Production release lacks a CLI-level explicit approval flag.
Custom web origins are configured for R2 but omitted from API CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.
Bootstrap workflow maps the selected environment's secrets into both staging and production variable names.
Deployment tools use pinned but dynamically downloaded npx CLIs; live execution requires reachable overseas package/platform endpoints.
rationale: Establish a non-mutating deployment safety baseline before changing infrastructure automation.
